title: Monday Night Game Packs: Eagles vs. Bears - Jalen Hurts, Rome Odunze, and 50k Bounties
summary: The Eagles and Bears square off on Monday Night Football, and we've got special packs—and bounties—to celebrate
body_markdown:
Back in 1991, *Saturday Night Live* introduced the world to Bill Swerski. It didn’t take long for[the “Superfans” skit](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kBnnon_iZOM) to become beloved among[Chicago Bears](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Chicago%20Bears&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) fans and those needing a laugh alike.


Tonight at 7:15 p.m. Central (8:15 p.m. ET) on ESPN and ABC, the Bears (1-1) and Philadelphia Eagles (2-0) square off in the last game of Week 3 of the 2026 NFL season. If SNL still had Swerski ranting about Da Bears, he’d have a whole lot to say after a 59-point Week 1, and a 3-point Week 2.


With superstar quarterback[Caleb Willaims](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Caleb%20Williams&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) officially ruled out with a hamstring injury (yes, he’s going to live!), the Eagles are 4.5-point favorites on the road. Even still, both teams have plenty of talent, making for an exciting Monday Night Football matchup between two of the NFC’s most storied franchises. And for[football](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine?category=football) fans on Courtyard, the latest weekly[Monday Night Game Pack](https://courtyard.io/vending-machine/football-mnf-eagles-bears) is a great way to get closer to the action—and chase bounty cards in the process.


Don’t get a delay of game. This Limited Drop pack is only available for 24 hours!


## **Next Man Up:**


Chicago’s Week 1 was all fireworks. Caleb Williams threw for 269 yards and two touchdowns, running for 65 more yards and two additional TDs on the ground, while rising star Rome Odunze caught eight of nine targets for 84 yards as the Bears rolled past[Bryce Young](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Bryce%20Young&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) and the Carolina Panthers 59-37. Then came a rainy 9-3 loss at home to the Minnesota Vikings that saw Williams leave the game due to injury in the fourth quarter.


With well-paid backup[Tyson Bagent](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Tyson%20Bagent&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) having cleared concussion protocol—an injury he suffered on his second play of last week’s game—there’s a chance he starts for Chicago, but the Bears appear to be preparing to trot out 38-year-old Case Keenum for his first start since 2023 instead. Expect the Bears to run the ball. A lot.


## **The Eagles Are Winning Ugly:**


Philly is 2-0 by a combined six points: a 24-22 squeaker over the Washington Commanders in Week 1, followed by a 24-20 comeback in Tennessee a week later that saw Eagles QB[Jalen Hurts](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Jalen%20Hurts&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) throw two picks before leading a game-winning two-minute drill, capped by a touchdown with just nine seconds left. If that’s not the Eagles experience in a nutshell, we don’t know what is.


With[A.J. Brown](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=A.J.%20Brown&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) now in New England,[DeVonta Smith](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Devonta%20Smith&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) is the undisputed WR1 in Philly, posting 10 catches for 117 yards and a score in Nashville.[Saquon Barkley](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Saquon%20Barkley&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) , meanwhile, has just 92 rushing yards through two games and is listed as questionable, albeit with[a MRI result](https://bleacherreport.com/articles/25502765-saquon-barkley-injury-update-latest-rumors-eagles-rbs-status-week-3-vs-bears) that’ll have Philly fans thanking their lucky stars. Tight end[Dallas Goedert](https://courtyard.io/marketplace?marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5Bquery%5D=Dallas%20Goedert&marketplace_prod_recently_listed%5BsortBy%5D=marketplace_prod_price_high_to_low) is out for MNF with a sprained MCL that is set to keep him on the sidelines for multiple weeks.
